kurz: Chocolate is cocoa mass, cocoa butter and sugar. The cocoa butter decides shine and snap; water is its biggest enemy.
bild_im_kopf: Like a fine crystal lattice that both heat and water can throw off balance.
was_passiert: Cocoa butter melts just below body temperature, which is why chocolate melts in the mouth. A little water makes it seize; a lot of liquid makes a smooth ganache.
faustregeln: Either no water at all or enough of it, at least a quarter of the chocolate's weight (as a guide).
Melt gently, over a water bath or in short microwave bursts.
